title: Disappointed
body:
Initially took advantage of the free month with Brili I really liked it but things turned sour when I started a paid subscription. My notifications started coming through intermittently and sometimes not at all. I reached out to support and am still waiting for a response a week later. I do not believe this is good customer service as this app is expensive. 

Don’t waste your money, there are plenty of other routine apps out there.
author: Redfrognight
